query:
SELECT 
  pbq.id as quote_id, pbq.panel_beater_name, pbq.total_amount, pbq.status, pbq.created_at,
  qli.id as item_id, qli.component_name, qli.description, qli.unit_price, qli.quantity, qli.total_price, qli.repair_type
FROM panel_beater_quotes pbq
LEFT JOIN quote_line_items qli ON qli.quote_id = pbq.id
WHERE pbq.claim_id = '6240003'
ORDER BY pbq.id, qli.id
LIMIT 100;
